code.content:
def parse_line(line):
    import re
    pattern = r'(?P<ip>\S+) - - \[(?P<time>[^\]]+)\] "(?P<method>\S+) (?P<path>\S+) \S+" (?P<status>\d+) (?P<bytes>\S+) (?P<seconds>\S+)'
    match = re.match(pattern, line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("Line does not match the expected format")
    
    data = match.groupdict()
    data['status'] = int(data['status'])
    data['bytes'] = int(data['bytes']) if data['bytes'] != '-' else 0
    data['seconds'] = float(data['seconds'])
    
    return data

import re
paragraphs = text.split('\n\n')
heading_pattern = re.compile(r'^(#{1,3})\s+(.*)$')
escaped_paragraphs = []
for paragraph in paragraphs:
    lines = paragraph.split('\n')
    escaped_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        match = heading_pattern.match(line)
        if match:
            level, content = match.groups()
            tag = f'h{len(level)}'
            escaped_lines.append(f'<{tag}>{html.escape(content)}</{tag}>')
        else:
            escaped_lines.append(html.escape(line.replace('\n', ' ')))
    escaped_paragraphs.append('\n'.join(escaped_lines))
return '\n'.join(escaped_paragraphs)
return '\n'.join(escaped_paragraphs)
return '\n'.join(escaped_paragraphs)
return '\n'.join(escaped_paragraphs)
